hint.text:
If a subordinate clause is at the beginning of a sentence, then there must be a comma after it.

If a subordinate clause is at the end of a sentence, there should not be a comma between the clauses.

instruction.text: Build a sentence with a main clause, a conjunction and a subordinate clause.

elements: I do not like hot weather
I want to go to Madrid in June
Liam went in the hot air balloon
